mutations.because: Revert M1: isDefaultOutput stops consulting state.sizes, so a draft carrying display sizes with otherwise-default formats and platforms reads as the absent-key default again and toBrief drops the whole output block — the authored sizes never reach the saved document.
command: a draft holding display sizes with otherwise-default output emits the block, sizes included

mutations.because: The false-positive half: invert the new term so a genuinely default draft — no sizes at all — is no longer the default. Every classic brief that has always omitted output starts emitting one. A term that was merely always-true would satisfy the sizes test above and break exactly this.
command: a genuinely default draft still omits output in both modes

mutations.because: The same inversion read as a round-trip fault: a brief on disk that never declared output loads, saves, and now grows a block it never had — the merge gate the whole-corpus round-trip exists to hold, and the reason a freshly loaded file would read as dirty.
command: a brief that omitted output loads, saves and still omits it

mutations.because: Make the policy hash cover motionRatios unconditionally. motionRatios is the one policy field derived from output.platforms, and it is exactly why the new output block could have moved policyHash: absent output means every ratio may carry a clip, the three static profiles package motion at none. With the conditional gone the two projections hash differently and the stability claim this lane makes about policyHash is false — so the assertion is not a tautology about a hasher that answers the same thing twice.
command: the pre-M1 projection and the post-M1 one resolve the same policyHash
